issues.title: Exact non-reproducible ELF fingerprint was stored as portable source authority
issues.resolution: Attestation moved to ignored machine-local state and now binds executable, source, Makefile, architecture, exact nvcc version, device identity, and qualification summary.

issues.title: Runtime-qualified backends were hidden when the active graph was incompatible
issues.resolution: Discovery state now preserves runtimeCapabilities separately from active capabilities; panel and A-E regressions verify truthful display without model/action exposure.

issues.title: First qwen CUDA proposal reused OpenMP threads and omitted deviceId
issues.resolution: Strict schema rejected it with no action; backend-specific contract and canonical CUDA shape were hardened.

issues.title: Fresh qwen requalification produced invalid device/timeout fields
issues.resolution: Strict validation again rejected it with no action; bounded orchestrator temperature was set to zero and literal typed defaults were clarified; final live gate passed.
